subject: Kickoff: concept bottleneck policies for auditable agents
body:
Hi Santiago,

Kicking off interpretable multi-agent RL. Base is our open-source Concept MARL work: concept bottleneck policies that extend MultiAgent-PPO (on Acme) with a concept loss, so each agent's policy routes through human-interpretable concepts — positions, held objects, teammate state — instead of an opaque embedding. Environments come from our Melting Pot ports: Collaborative Cooking, Clean Up, Capture the Flag, plus the miniature cooking variants for fast iteration.

Product motivation: the agents roadmap keeps hitting the auditability wall — customers ask why an agent did something and we have nothing. Concept bottlenecks are the credible answer.

Half plan: training reproduced by mid-May, concept-quality evals in June, LRB-ready interpretability demo by the 7/20 window close. Staffing and compute by mid-April?

Ulla
